error_note_zh: 制造商名称“Cockhill Pit Factory”疑为“Cockpit Hill Factory”（德比 Cockpit Hill 陶厂，18世纪中期确曾生产纪念《印花税法》废除的茶壶）的字母顺序讹误，建议核实馆方原始记录是否存在拼写/转写错误，以免展品说明中厂名与史实对不上。
error_note_en: The manufacturer name "Cockhill Pit Factory" appears to be a letter-order error for "Cockpit Hill Factory" (Cockpit Hill pottery in Derby, which indeed produced teapots commemorating the Stamp Act repeal in the mid-18th century); it is recommended to verify whether there are spelling/transcription errors in institutional records to avoid discrepancies between the factory name in display text and historical fact.

error_note_zh: 简介归类字段写作“泥板岩”（对应英文 Argillite 的标准译法），但 material 元数据字段却记作“硅质页岩”——这是两种不同的岩石（泥质变质岩 vs 富硅页岩），同一件器物在不同字段里被赋予了互相矛盾的材质名称，属于内部自相矛盾。
error_note_en: The description category field is written as "argillite" (standard translation of English Argillite), but the material metadata field records it as "siliceous shale"—these are two different rocks (argillaceous metamorphic rock vs. silica-rich shale); the same object has been assigned contradictory material names in different fields, constituting internal contradiction.
